# Archived prototype fixtures

These unchanged files preserve real prototype archives and their original provenance
below. The current application rejects this format without changing the file;
`tests/document-archive.test.ts` checks that boundary. References to the “current
reader” and future migrations below describe the historical prototype only.
Producer sources and the old paths are recoverable at Git revision
`3a4615641204f3a90683c590f52bfe3f81b29f87`.

# Legacy storage fixture

`legacy-v4-rectangles.bin` is an actual v4 archive produced by the pre-migration
`p1_multiple_rectangle_persistence_scenario` executable on Darwin arm64. It was
copied from `/private/tmp/freac-legacy-v4-20260913.bin`; it was not made by changing
the version byte of a v5 archive.

- Archive SHA-256: `3c06a3c5b1f8227e7fc95bcd5d289886b1889c43e8291f5437da57c4e7042fad`
- Size: 58,080 bytes; magic `FREACP1C`, version 4.
- Producer executable SHA-256: `a6b0fd5da16bdf3f1456131d3a5f4e96a8ea4b1a62a6998f6d55a8e275fe4f5a`
- Generated and checked on 2026-09-13 with the existing executable, without rebuilding.

```sh
.cache/p1-domain-build/p1_multiple_rectangle_persistence_scenario write /private/tmp/freac-legacy-v4-20260913.bin
.cache/p1-domain-build/p1_multiple_rectangle_persistence_scenario read /private/tmp/freac-legacy-v4-20260913.bin
```

The adjacent manifest is the scenario's identity/operation evidence. It contains
two rectangles, two positive-depth captured operations and nonempty undo/redo
history. The fixture does not cover negative-depth v4 content. Keep these bytes
unchanged as new writers evolve; migration checks must use the old file with the
new reader. Native fixture acceptance does not establish ordinary UI reopening.

## Signed v5 archive

`legacy-v5-signed.bin` was produced without rebuilding by the existing
`p1_signed_capture_scenario write` mode and accepted by its `read` mode.
It has magic FREACP1C, version 5 and size 15,068 bytes.

- Archive SHA-256: `c9e754a4d3175c2f7eb9868031c260643586547914ea1640b5e5a37306d652d2`
- Producer executable SHA-256: `6a7513cd543a5ebf1744830038c3b2de4808c35260431723573c294667d215da`

The current 20×10 capture has original depth -5 and volume 1000. Original redo
restores an outward terminal-cap offset of 2, moving the cap to local Z=-7 and
yielding volume 1400; the original extrusion depth remains -5. The scenario
compares capture and rectangle identity through restore and redo. Its writer
does not emit a sidecar manifest. Retain these genuine v5 bytes for subsequent
capture-workspace ownership migration checks.

## Framed v6 archive

`legacy-v6-framed.bin` was generated by the existing, unrelinked v6
`p1_origin_framed_archive_scenario` executable and accepted by its read mode
before the v7 build. Its version field was independently checked as 6. These
bytes were preserved unchanged; they were not produced by relabeling v7 data.

- Size: 22,302 bytes.
- Archive SHA-256: `c3e8053eb83ef313cd99cb612a12829b4fe0e0d955487d5e6214736c6742f4ce`.
- Producer executable SHA-256: `fb11548d2be2448c0a45c23f26c72772f0b44b2d0e1a4d0126e06555e562d7bd`.
- Producer executable size: 10,384,352 bytes.
- Source revision: `5141bc2`, before the pending v7 migration.

```sh
.cache/p1-domain-build/p1_origin_framed_archive_scenario write /private/tmp/freac-legacy-v6-framed.bin
.cache/p1-domain-build/p1_origin_framed_archive_scenario read /private/tmp/freac-legacy-v6-framed.bin
```

The scenario covers origin-plane framed operations and history. It does not
contain face-supported workspaces, which were deliberately unsavable in v6.

## Face-supported v7 archive

`legacy-v7-face-workspaces.bin` was generated and read successfully with the
existing `p1_face_workspace_persistence_scenario` executable before body-registry
archive integration. The header independently reports version 7; the bytes have
not been relabeled. Source HEAD at generation was `75795e3`.

- Size: 88,865 bytes; magic `FREACP1C`.
- Archive SHA-256: `708b3259a02719984741079d3033c625b9566a0c71683533aba2cba118fff8dc`.
- Producer executable SHA-256: `64cc987866b493290af4773b8aa6fbc29573f677ba6634b67f71b84b5a3e8a0f`.

```sh
.cache/p1-domain-build/p1_face_workspace_persistence_scenario write proofs/p1/domain/fixtures/legacy-v7-face-workspaces.bin proofs/p1/domain/fixtures/legacy-v7-face-workspaces.txt
.cache/p1-domain-build/p1_face_workspace_persistence_scenario read proofs/p1/domain/fixtures/legacy-v7-face-workspaces.bin proofs/p1/domain/fixtures/legacy-v7-face-workspaces.txt
```

The fixture retains a side-supported rectangle and its dependent extrusion,
producer resizing and face offset, plus two redo entries restoring cap drawing
and a dependent rectangle resize. Its adjacent manifest records identities.
The current reader verifies attachment frames, dependent volume/world bounds,
history execution, allocator continuation and rejection of old-session picks.
This preserves input for a future v8 migration test; it does not yet establish
that migration or ordinary UI reopening.

## Body-history v8 archive

`legacy-v8-body-history.bin` was generated by the v8
`p1_body_persistence_scenario` at source revision `d3ed4fd`, before Boolean
operation persistence changes. Separate writer/read processes passed using
`/private/tmp/freac-body-v8.bin`; the archive and derived `.manifest` were then
copied here unchanged.

- Size: 21,619 bytes; version 8 checked by the writer scenario.
- Archive SHA-256: `5a71be3891a10bd57bf978b90a1c9d8ea8c78c02fded2436c9b51a5c3b6db771`.
- Producer executable SHA-256: `67e7ac48416d65950a4a76f4e3bcb3aff94f0f9c68be12fe977e140b4730ae73`.

The current state contains `body-1` / `operation-1`; `body-2` / `operation-2`
is retained in redo history. The next body counter is 3. The adjacent manifest
records both states' identities and the writer session. This preserves genuine
v8 input for future operation-format migration, not evidence that such migration
is already implemented. Run writer/read modes in a temporary directory: read
mode also emits a `.v8` round-trip output.
